rationale: Targeted re-check of the 8 blocking findings from code-review-final.json against the fix-up diff (24fba6516..0280bf3d0). All 8 findings are resolved: the migration now locks only the current batch's row ids (not the whole table), dry-run uses a non-locking SELECT and warns on 1000-group truncation, 'Default'-named groups are excluded, array binds carry explicit ARRAY types, delete_conversation_folder and validate_fields both normalize whitespace in place, and the 3 previously-untested write paths plus the migration's locking/exclusion/apply-mode branches now have passing regression tests (41 tests across the touched files, all green).

business_review.reason: Repo-wide test convention (tests/conftest.py::mock_database_engine, autouse) mocks the DB engine for every test, so a live-Postgres execution test isn't available in this repo's existing infra. Added dialect-level compilation checks (sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql) for every raw statement including the typed ARRAY binds, which is the strongest check achievable without adding new test infrastructure — that gap is now explicitly documented in the test file rather than silently absent.

business_review.criterion: Testing: apply-mode assertion for both colliding and non-colliding groups

finding_status.note: Locking is now scoped to the current batch's row ids via a bounded FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED on SELECT id FROM conversation_folders WHERE id = ANY(:ids), not the whole table.
Dry-run now executes only the non-locking _DETECT_GROUPS_SQL (no FOR UPDATE clause); apply-mode locking is a separate, later statement.
Dry-run prints an explicit 'truncated at 1000 groups' warning when len(groups) == 1000; covered by test_upgrade_dry_run_warns_when_truncated_at_1000_groups.

All array-valued bind params (ids, original_names, losing_ids) now carry explicit bindparam(..., type_=ARRAY(String)) typing; added dialect-compilation tests for every raw statement. Full live-driver execution remains infeasible given the repo's autouse DB-engine mock, documented in the test file.

delete_conversation_folder now trims its folder parameter before both the Conversation lookup and ConversationFolder.delete_by_folder call; covered by test_delete_conversation_folder_trims_folder_name_for_lookup.

validate_fields now assigns self.folder_name = self.folder_name.strip() in place before the uniqueness/forbidden-name checks, so any construction path is normalized before persistence; covered by test_validate_fields_mutates_folder_name_in_place_for_callers_bypassing_create_folder.

Detection query now excludes trimmed_name = 'Default' via a WHERE clause, so no group can rename an existing folder into the reserved name; covered by test_upgrade_dry_run_excludes_default_folder_name.

Added service-layer trim tests for create_conversation, _create_conversation_with_history, and update_conversation (the 3 previously-uncovered write paths), plus migration tests for the batching/locking behavior and both apply-mode branches (collision and non-collision).
